title: Honey
overview: Childhood friends Satakshi and Madhyama reunite at a celebration during Durga Puja. As the night progresses, their feelings for one another are revealed to us through words of the past and the future, taking the audience on a beautiful Ferris wheel ride of love, hopes, and dreams.

songs.title: Saiyaan Ji (Ft. Nushrratt Bharuccha)
songs.singers: Yo Yo Honey Singh, Neha Kakkar
